image.scene_action_relation_crop: Upper-right two adult torsos/busts share one 75–85 px-wide pouch above a short table segment. Giver holds an upper-side seam; receiver supports base with one palm. Only two action hands, with separate visible wrists. A second completed pouch rests nearby as the other offering. Lower-left an approximately 190 px-wide source T-shirt lies flat on the same simply indicated table; collar/sleeve junction and selected torso panel remain visible. No elaborate room perspective, crowded workshop or extra sewing action.

necessary_features: Source torso contains broad diagonal edge repair and a small offset stripe junction.
Exchanged pouch retains repair/junction within its assembled front; mouth/bottom seam distinguish it from cloth.
One adult wrist owns the side-seam grip and the other owns the supporting base palm above table.
intentional_changes: Only torso panel reused; neckline/sleeves removed.
Simplify fingers/folds to large painted contours but preserve support/contact boundaries.
Other offering uses different fabric rather than duplicating a product.
transformation.relationship_limit: Linked source/exchange vignettes, not an invented prescribed workshop sequence.

nearest_direction_stripped_comparison.comparison: These are closest because both have left Korean identity and upper-right sharing imagery. Removing colour/material shows M4 still has a source garment in the lower-left, exchange in the upper-right, a compact name at the top and facts stepping through the centre into lower-right. M5 has a full-width English masthead, source/result/sharing combined in one upper-right emblem, Korean identity beneath the masthead, attendance low on the left and participation low on the right. M4 uses a connected adult table scene to organise the entire space; M5 uses a compact comparative graphic within a strong asymmetric typographic broadside.

common_constraints: Print every supplied entry exactly once, with readable Korean/English and intact punctuation; no added text, logos, pseudo-print, watermark or QR.
Each result is one separate flat opaque landscape16:9 poster, not a stretched/cropped portrait or a contact sheet.
Five genuinely distinct complete visual systems, composition, image/type roles and impressions, beyond material/filter/palette changes.
Substantive content-grounded nonglyph visual construction required; type/whitespace-only, tiny icon/texture and glyph-model-only loopholes prohibited.

T-shirt-to-pouch upcycling and sharing completed pouches must be visibly connected, with an approachable adult daytime hobby-event tone. All supplied practical information must be readable at usage720.
